roles.name: 集成与治理
roles.goal: 交付可接续架构/科学指标/迁移方案及治理验证，再协调正式产品分工
roles.done_when: 当前任务满足cursor退出条件，精确证据和下一阶段边界齐全

roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-RX-READY-BATCH-005: Extend M1 owned RxOwner with caller-preallocated bounded <=32 ready-drain of uniquely-owned RX buffers and per-lane fair ingress; never authenticate or claim business delivery. Preserve first-arrival, unrelated-lane independence, stop/return and max slots/bytes/age.
roles.done_when: Exact own-source compiled-once native r1_ tests for empty/1/32/33, caller capacity0/full, no hot-path copy/allocation, two lanes with head obstruction, expiry/stop/loan return races. Preserve 39 previous tests; source S, native Actions, evidence S, cursor-only H and Governance; no production raw socket or Rust ABI changes.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2-M2-BATCH-EPOCH-RECEIPT-RACE-004: Strengthen pure M2 multi-tunnel batch grant completion against late ACK, stale generation, old epoch NotSent, client departure, repeat uncertain callback and mixed accepted-prefix repair; ensure no peer-delivery inference from kernel accepted outcomes and no fresh HOL. Only pure wbd-recovery types; no actual syscall.
roles.done_when: Exact own-source native r2_ deterministic MonoNs adversarial tests for 2 TunnelKeys and both directions, 0/1/32/33 mixed outcomes, >epoch late response, expired/departed grant, duplicate completion, bounded batch storage and unchanged process cap; preserve 28 earlier tests, own S/evidence/H Governance. Do not invent retransmission success.

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1-M3-AUTH-FEC-SCOPE-GATE-011: Add pure, fail-closed typed authenticated FEC scope admission tying already-verified record lane/direction/trusted epoch/generation and PN replay result to FecBlockIdOwner/FecRxOwner; reject absent origin, halfspace, stale retired IDs and unauthenticated field speculation. No Go exporter or ABI work.
roles.done_when: Exact own native r1_ fake-MonoNs tests: validated provenance permits first systematic immediately, wrong lane/tunnel/epoch/generation, replay before FEC, delayed parity and retired expiry rejected; old-Go 56B wire oracle preserved; keep prior 75 native cases and S/evidence/H Governance; Go V4 live binding remains NOT_RUN.

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-LINUX-RX-BATCH-005: Implement an explicitly unprivileged Linux x86_64 GNU bounded nonblocking recvmmsg batch fixture with caller supplied <=32 buffers, MSG_DONTWAIT, truncated datagram metadata fail closed and atomic stop borrowing. Reuse strict IPv4/TCP RX parser only when complete bytes are available; no AF_PACKET raw reader, Npcap, recv driver activation.
roles.done_when: Compiled-once own-source native platform r1_ tests execute real Linux UDP loopback recvmmsg with 0/1/32/33, EAGAIN, truncated/corrupt input, immutable lifetime and stop race; classifier-only EINTR/ambiguous noted separately. Keep previous 31 tests and own S/evidence/H Governance; no root Cargo/dependency edits.
